policy: Every real Roblox asset id in a committable file (rbxassetid://, rbxthumb://, roblox.com asset URLs, numeric AssetId/MeshId/TextureId/SoundId/AnimationId/ImageId/DecalId fields) must have an entry here; 0 is the only placeholder. Only entries with approval 'approved' (reviewer and script_review filled in by the roblox-asset-intake skill) may appear in place content (.luau, .lua, .rbxmx, .rbxlx, .project.json, .model.json, .meta.json). Checked by the gate step asset-provenance and release check A10.

fields.kind: model, mesh, image, audio, animation, plugin, place, bundle, badge or pass
fields.name: display name at the source
fields.source: URL where the asset was found, or 'own upload'
fields.creator: publisher at the source
fields.license: licence or terms as read at the source; 'not inspected' when unknown
fields.script_review: script and security review findings (required for approved)
fields.purpose: why the id is in the repo and where it is used
fields.origin: intake (reviewed in this repo) or own_upload
